'''Corrida''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that the treasure hunter [[Vette]] visited sometime during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She nearly [[Death/Legends|died]] while exploring a cave there.<ref name="TOR" />
